mapper.sql: ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, PRICE, SALE_PRICE, STOCK_QTY, STATUS_CODE, IMAGE_URL, DESCRIPTION, REG_USER, REG_DATE, UPD_DATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ITEM ( ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, PRICE, SALE_PRICE, STOCK_QTY, STATUS_CODE, IMAGE_URL, DESCRIPTION, REG_USER, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{itemName}, #{categoryCode}, #{price}, #{salePrice, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{stockQty}, #{statusCode}, #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{regUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ITEM
ORDER BY COALESCE(SALE_PRICE, PRICE) ASC, ITEM_ID DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(SALE_PRICE, PRICE) DESC, ITEM_ID DESC
ORDER BY ITEM_NAME ASC, ITEM_ID DESC
ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC, ITEM_ID DESC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
